steps.output:
from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    wall = Counter(grid[0]).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row.count(wall) > w / 2]
    cols = [c for c in range(1, w) if sum(grid[r][c] == wall for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    fill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != wall).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)] for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]
    for i in range(len(rows) - 1):
        top, bottom = rows[i], rows[i + 1]
        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
            left, right = cols[j], cols[j + 1]
            a, b = grid[top][left], grid[top][right]
            c, d = grid[bottom][left], grid[bottom][right]
            if a != wall and a == b == c == d:
                out[i][j] = a
            elif i == 0 and a != wall and a == b:
                out[i][j] = a
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)

    out = [[fill for _ in range(len(cols) - 1)] for _ in range(len(rows) - 1)]

        for j in range(len(cols) - 1):
